content: Mikolov and collaborors introduce a new evaluation scheme based on word analogies that examines dimensions of difference in vector space, as opposed to scalar distances between vectors BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 . In order to validate the quality of the located embeddings, we thus follow current standard practice and assess whether reasonable linear combinations of words can be returned. The main body of the paper presents three examples, and a further example is presented here: DISPLAYFORM0
